title: English Practice Quiz 0983
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A shop assistant asks, 'Can I help you?' You can reply:
questions.explanation: This is a natural way to browse without assistance.

questions.question: A 'refund' is money ___.
questions.explanation: A refund is money given back after a purchase.

questions.question: If an item is 'out of stock', it is ___.
questions.explanation: Out of stock means the shop has none available.

questions.question: Which question asks about a product's size?
options: What size is this available in?
questions.explanation: This asks which sizes the shop has.

questions.question: A warranty provides ___.
options: a promise of repair or replacement under stated terms
a guaranteed discount on every item
questions.explanation: A warranty covers specified faults or repairs for a period.

questions.question: To 'exchange' an item means to ___.
questions.explanation: An exchange replaces one purchased item with another.

questions.question: Which detail should you check before paying online?
options: the seller and payment page are genuine
questions.explanation: Checking the seller and payment page helps reduce fraud risk.

questions.question: A 'receipt' is useful because it ___.
questions.explanation: A receipt is evidence of a transaction.

questions.question: If a parcel arrives damaged, you should ___.
options: photograph the damage and contact the seller
questions.explanation: Evidence and prompt contact help resolve delivery issues.

questions.question: A 'cashless' payment is made ___.
questions.explanation: Cashless payments use digital or other non-cash methods.
